thesis: Extraordinary growth prevents a confident sell ruling, but valuation-basis and cash-conversion gaps defeat an immediate buy at 83.82x. The bear carries the entry argument, not a claim that operations are deteriorating.
strongest_counterexample: H1 revenue grew 98% and attributable profit 160.5%, with low leverage supporting expansion.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive normalized EPS growth with FCF/net income above 0.8.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of declining normalized EPS.
evidence_gaps: Tax-normalized earnings, matched valuation period and receivable collection.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Exceptional reported growth and low leverage support operating capacity
Exceptional reported growth deserves weight, but tax effects, low snapshot cash conversion and conflicting earnings bases prevent assigning the growth a reliable valuation
